examples.name: Simple Step
examples.description: Minimal workflow with a single step
examples.learningGoal: See the smallest durable workflow declaration.
examples.expectedOutput: Declares a one-step workflow (use retry_and_inspect to run and inspect).

examples.name: Determinism Helpers
examples.description: now() inside a helper is allowed in a step; the same helper from the workflow body is WF1001
examples.learningGoal: See that workflow determinism follows in-file helpers, not only direct built-in names.
examples.expectedOutput: Prints instance id and COMPLETED status after stamping the clock inside a step.

examples.name: Retry and Inspect
examples.description: startWorkflow with retry, inspect FAILED instances, peek dead letters
examples.learningGoal: Run local durable workflows, recover from flaky steps, and inspect failures without cloud infra.
examples.expectedOutput: Prints a successful retry run, then FAILED inspection and dead-letter count; exits 0.

examples.name: Ops Report
examples.description: Seed a FAILED instance for malda workflow report (timeline + steps + DLQ)
examples.learningGoal: Use the unified CLI ops report after a terminal failure.
examples.expectedOutput: Prints instanceId and CLI report commands; exits 0 after expected failure.
